failure_annotations.explanation: Following closure near the tape-end area, the gripper draws the towel into folds instead of securely acquiring and extending the tape end: left at frames 1109–1125 shows fabric gathering toward the fingers while the housing tilts and turns over, ending reverse-side up at frame 1127. top corroborates the towel's displacement and bunching. This is an incorrect acquisition/contact attempt; the images do not establish that the housing was held and then dropped. Reopening at frame 1128 begins recovery.
failure_annotations.recovery: Release any caught fabric, flatten the towel, and reposition the housing securely before aligning the fingertips around only the tape-end tab; verify retention with a short controlled extension. Human intervention is not clearly necessary.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The towel is bunched and the housing overturned on the work surface, but no tearing, breakage, or meaningful damage risk is visible in left or top.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: A straightforward reset would smooth the towel and reorient the accessible tape measure; no retrieval from an inaccessible location or repair is indicated.
